24035-the-pirates-of-ersatz.creator: Unknown
24035-the-pirates-of-ersatz.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. his ambitions were about to be realized. At practically any instant his brilliance would be discovered and he'd be well-to-do, his friend Derec would admire him, and even Nedda would probably decide to marry him right away. She was the delightful girl. Such prospects made for good sleeping.

arxiv-2012-05696.title: A User-experience Driven SSIM-Aware Adaptation Approach for DASH Video Streaming
arxiv-2012-05696.creator: Mustafa Othman, Ken Chen, Anissa Mokraoui
arxiv-2012-05696.description: Abstract Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) is a video streaming technique largely used. One key point is the adaptation mechanism which resides at the client’s side. This mechanism impacts greatly on the overall Quality of Experience (QoE) of the video streaming. In this paper, we propose a new adaptation algorithm for DASH, namely SSIM Based Adaptation (SBA).

arxiv-2103-04432.title: Portfolio Optimization Constrained by Performance Attribution
arxiv-2103-04432.creator: Yuan Hu and W. Brent Lindquist
arxiv-2103-04432.description: Abstract Abstract This paper investigates performance attribution measures as a basis for constraining portfolio optimization. We employ optimizations that minimize expected tail loss and investigate both asset allocation (AA) and the selection effect (SE) as hard constraints on asset weights.

arxiv-2111-12193.title: Multiset-Equivariant Set Prediction with Approximate Implicit Differentiation
arxiv-2111-12193.creator: Yan Zhang, David W. Zhang, Simon Lacoste-Julien, Gertjan J. Burghouts, Cees G. M. Snoek, Samsung - SAIT AI Lab, Montreal University of Amsterdam, Mila, Université de Montreal Canada CIFAR AI Chair TNO
arxiv-2111-12193.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yan Zhang, David W. Zhang, Simon Lacoste-Julien, Gertjan J. Burghouts, Cees G. M. Snoek, Samsung - SAIT AI Lab, Montreal University of Amsterdam, Mila, Université de Montreal Canada CIFAR AI Chair TNO. Most set prediction models in deep learning use set-equivariant operations, but they actually operate on multisets. We show that set-equivariant functions cannot represent certain functions on multisets, so we introduce the more appropriate notion of multiset-equivariance .

arxiv-2112-08346.title: Simple Text Detoxification by Identifying a Linear Toxic Subspace in Language Model Embeddings
arxiv-2112-08346.creator: Andrew Wang, Mohit Sudhakar, Yangfeng Ji
arxiv-2112-08346.description: Abstract Large pre-trained language models are often trained on large volumes of internet data, some of which may contain toxic or abusive language. Consequently, language models encode toxic information, which makes the real-world usage of these language models limited. Current methods aim to prevent toxic features from appearing generated text.

arxiv-2211-08337.title: Hopf algebras of multiple polylogarithms, and holomorphic 1-forms Thanks: C. Z. was supported in part by DMS-1711405. 2020 Mathematics Classification. Primary 11G55. Secondary 19E15, 14D07, 32G20. Key words and phrases: Hopf algebras of polylogarithms, variation matrices, iterated integrals, multipl
arxiv-2211-08337.creator: Zachary Greenberg, Dani Kaufman, Haoran Li, Christian K. Zickert
arxiv-2211-08337.description: Abstract . We associate to a multiple polylogarithm a holomorphic 1-form on the universal abelian cover of its domain. We relate the 1-forms to the symbol and variation matrix and show that the 1-forms naturally define a lift of the variation of mixed Hodge structure associated to a polylogarithm.

arxiv-2212-02299.title: A versatile cryogenic system for liquid argon detectors
arxiv-2212-02299.creator: G. Fiorillo
arxiv-2212-02299.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by G. Fiorillo. Detectors for direct dark matter search using noble gases in liquid phase as detection medium need to be coupled to liquefaction, purification and recirculation systems. A dedicated cryogenic system has been assembled and operated at the INFN-Naples cryogenic laboratory with the aim to liquefy and purify the argon used as active target in liquid argon detectors to study the scintillation and ionization signals detected by large SiPMs arrays.

arxiv-2304-03388.title: EZClone: Improving DNN Model Extraction Attack via Shape Distillation from GPU Execution Profiles
arxiv-2304-03388.creator: Jonah O’Brien Weiss, Tiago Alves, Sandip Kundu
arxiv-2304-03388.description: Abstract Figure 1: GPU kernel feature values for all 36 PyTorch vision architectures by architecture family. Values are averaged over 50 profiles and normalized. The features are ranked from the set of non-memory related GPU kernels using Recursive Feature Elimination on a Random Forest model, which achieves 100% architecture prediction accuracy using the top 3 features.

arxiv-2402-12332.title: Triple-Encoders: Representations That Fire Together, Wire Together
arxiv-2402-12332.creator: Justus-Jonas Erker, Florian Mai, Nils Reimers, Gerasimos Spanakis, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2402-12332.description: Abstract Search-based dialog models typically re-encode the dialog history at every turn, incurring high cost. Curved Contrastive Learning, a representation learning method that encodes relative distances between utterances into the embedding space via a bi-encoder, has recently shown promising results for dialog modeling at far superior efficiency.

arxiv-2409-01784.creator: Shashank K. Shukla, Gobinda Rakshit
arxiv-2409-01784.description: Abstract Consider a non-linear operator equation x − K ⁡ ( x ) = f x-K(x)=f , where f f is a given function and K K is a Urysohn integral operator with Green’s function type kernel defined on L ∞ ​ [ 0 , 1 ] L^{\infty}[0,1] .

arxiv-2410-03681.title: Gaussian Level-Set Percolation on Complex Networks
arxiv-2410-03681.creator: Reimer Kühn
arxiv-2410-03681.description: Abstract We present a solution of the problem of level-set percolation for multivariate Gaussians defined in terms of weighted graph Laplacians on complex networks. It is achieved using a cavity or message passing approach, which allows one to obtain the essential ingredient required for the solution, viz. a self-consistent determination of locally varying percolation probabilities.

arxiv-2412-17989.title: Multilevel Method
arxiv-2412-17989.creator: with Low-Order Equations of Mixed Types
arxiv-2412-17989.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by with Low-Order Equations of Mixed Types. Thermal radiative transfer (TRT) is an essential piece of physics in inertial confinement fusion, high-energy density physics, astrophysics etc. The physical models of this type of problem are defined by strongly coupled differential equations describing multiphysics phenomena. This paper presents a new nonlinear multilevel iterative method with two photon energy grids for solving the multigroup radiative transfer equation (RTE) coupled with the material energy balance equation (MEB).

arxiv-2501-18185.title: MetaWave : A Platform for Unified Implementation of Nonrelativistic and Relativistic Wavefunctions
arxiv-2501-18185.creator: Ning Zhang, Qingpeng Wang, Wenjian Liu
arxiv-2501-18185.description: Abstract MetaWave is a C++ template-based architecture designed for unified implementation of nonrelativistic and relativistic wavefunction-based quantum chemical methods. arxiv-2504-06723.title: 5-dimensional minimal quadratic and bilinear forms over function fields of conics
arxiv-2504-06723.creator: Adam Chapman, Ahmed Laghribi
arxiv-2504-06723.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Adam Chapman, Ahmed Laghribi. Over a field of characteristic 2 2 , we give a complete classification of quadratic and bilinear forms of dimension 5 5 that are minimal over the function field of an arbitrary conic. This completes the unique known case due to Faivre concerning the classification of minimal quadratic forms of dimension 5 5 and type ( 2 , 1 ) (2,1) over function fields of nonsingular conics. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 11E04, 11E81 1.

arxiv-2509-17632.title: Overview of PlantCLEF 2022: Image-based plant identification at global scale
arxiv-2509-17632.creator: Hervé Goëau, Pierre Bonnet, Alexis Joly
arxiv-2509-17632.description: Abstract It is estimated that there are more than 300,000 species of vascular plants in the world. Increasing our knowledge of these species is of paramount importance for the development of human civilization (agriculture, construction, pharmacopoeia, etc.), especially in the context of the biodiversity crisis.

arxiv-2511-17730.title: Safety and Risk Pathways in Cooperative Generative Multi-Agent Systems: A Telecom Perspective CCS: Computing methodologies Multi-agent planning CCS: Computing methodologies Simulation evaluation CCS: Networks Wireless access networks
arxiv-2511-17730.creator: Zeinab Nezami, Shehr Bano, Abdelaziz Salama, Maryam Hafeez, Syed Ali Raza Zaidi
arxiv-2511-17730.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zeinab Nezami, Shehr Bano, Abdelaziz Salama, Maryam Hafeez, Syed Ali Raza Zaidi. Generative multi-agent systems are rapidly emerging as transformative tools for scalable automation and adaptive decision-making in telecommunications. Despite their promise, these systems introduce novel risks that remain underexplored, particularly when agents operate asynchronously across layered architectures. This paper investigates key safety pathways in telecom-focused Generative Multi-Agent Systems (GMAS), emphasizing risks of miscoordination and semantic drift shaped by persona diversity.

arxiv-2512-11601.title: Variants of Wythoff game with terminal
arxiv-2512-11601.description: Abstract We show how the software Walnut can be used to obtain concise proofs of results concerning variants of the famous Wythoff game, in which blocking maneuvers or terminal positions are added, as discussed respectively by Larsson (2011) and Komak et al. (2025).

pmc-11458870.title: Inhibition of neutrophil swarming by type I interferon promotes intracellular bacterial evasion
pmc-11458870.creator: Shimin Li, Qi Yao, Jiajia Li, Haoxiang Yang, Rui Qian, Meijuan Zheng, Ning Wu, Hongyuan Jiang, Lu Li, Zhutian Zeng
pmc-11458870.description: Listeria monocytogenes (LM) possesses the ability to breach multiple barriers and elicit intricate immune responses. However, there remains a lack of explicit understanding regarding how LM evades innate immune surveillance within the body. Here, we utilized liver intravital imaging to elucidate the dynamic process of LM during infection in the liver.

pmc-11688204.title: Advancements and future perspectives in nutrient film technique hydroponic system: a comprehensive review and bibliometric analysis
pmc-11688204.creator: Onofrio Davide Palmitessa, Angelo Signore, Pietro Santamaria
pmc-11688204.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In the context of climate change, reducing the environmental impact of agriculture has become increasingly critical. To ensure sustainable food production, it is essential to adopt cultivation techniques that maximize resource efficiency, particularly in water and nutrient usage. The Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) is one such hydroponic system, designed to optimize water and nutrient use, making it a valuable tool for sustainable agriculture.

pmc-12473355.title: Transcriptomic Analysis of Differential Gene Expression in Hevea brasiliensis Under Short-Term Cold Stress
pmc-12473355.creator: Madushi Vishmitha Weeramange, Chenrui Gu, Shichao Xin, Xiaochuan Gu, Bin Yi, Tiandai Huang
pmc-12473355.description: Cold stress limits the growth and productivity of Hevea brasiliensis, the primary source of natural rubber. This study investigated early transcriptomic responses in Reyan ‘7-33-97’ seedlings exposed to 4 °C, 10 °C, and 15 °C for 1, 2, and 4 h with room temperature (25 °C) as the control.

pmc-12679016.title: Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography and laparoscopic bile duct exploration should be standard procedures for patients with the ice-breaking sign?
pmc-12679016.creator: Lucia Mejuto, Maria Delgado, Luis R Rabago
pmc-12679016.description: The authors introduce a new magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) radiologic feature, the “ice-breaking sign” (IBS), and present a retrospective case-control study comparing patients with common bile duct stones who exhibit the IBS with a control group without this sign. The two groups were matched using a propensity score based on patient age and sex.

pmc-13092760.title: Estimation of the global number of nicotine vapers in 2025
pmc-13092760.creator: Tomasz Jerzyński, Giorgi Mzhavanadze, Gerry V. Stimson
pmc-13092760.description: BackgroundGlobal estimates of adult use of nicotine vaping devices are limited by uneven survey coverage and substantial gaps in country-level data. We therefore developed a structured three-stage approach to synthesize available evidence and generate approximate estimates of the current and projected global number of adult nicotine vaping users.MethodsWe used national survey data on vaping prevalence from 92 countries (2013−2023).

pmc-13230506.title: Development and early feasibility testing of machine-learning algorithms to non-invasively assess hemoglobin levels
pmc-13230506.creator: Simon Hefner, Philipp Stoffers, Benedikt Langenberger, Alix Holstein, Miha Garafolj, Christina Klötzer, Carmen Herling, Vladan Vucinic, Reinhard Henschler, Ariel Dora Stern, Uwe Platzbecker, Anne Sophie Platzbecker
pmc-13230506.description: The HeMonitor study evaluated the feasibility and accuracy of non-invasive hemoglobin (Hb) assessment using image-based techniques and machine learning in patients with hematologic malignancies. A total of 367 patients with hematologic malignancies and 184 healśśthy donors were enrolled, with fingernail and eyelid photographs collected and analyzed using Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LightGBM) regression models.
